suite.closed_failure_basis: Explicit synthetic grants, fresh-state and single-attempt/confirmation fixtures replace obsolete direct-send mocks. Missing cache requires fresh evidence; disabling the optional cache precheck cannot bypass mandatory fresh-state validation. Confirmation was retained and is also exercised using the real polling method.

proven: Default empty selection denies controls before HA observation
Unverified, missing, malformed or revoked private selection never reuses a previous grant
Strict boolean live verification, explicit operation and integer brightness bounds are required
Actor kind/scope and action origin are server-owned; a speaker annotation cannot act as authenticated principal
Requests queued on an entity lane or waiting for fresh HA state are reauthorized before send
Disabled/empty hooks do not disable the mandatory policy; rewrites to a hidden lock, target selector or excessive brightness are rejected
Lock, alarm, opaque scene/script, unselected target, unknown parameters and aggregate entity effects cannot be sent
HTTP session adapts to a typed actor and namespaced receipt; identity fields in the request body are rejected
Orchestrator, legacy voice router, persistent routine factory/executor, legacy executor and both reminder delivery paths consume the shared action boundary
Learned command executor also uses the boundary, although main does not construct it
Routine/reminder creation checks the current selection; execution rechecks revocation; revocation does not prevent disabling a routine
Accepted transport without observed requested state remains uncertain
Concurrent identical immediate requests share one send and receipt; type-changing reuse conflicts
Legacy routine manager cannot install HA-owned automation that would bypass policy on later execution
policy.application_wiring: main creates one action service before producers and injects it into both voice paths, reminder manager/scheduler, home services and persistent routines. Source inspected; constructor/factory graphs tested with doubles. Full application boot with real dependencies is still a release validation item.

proven: Immutable occurrence/action claim is committed before the shared service can send
Due and presence-arrival races share a single effect
Uncertain receipt survives lost scheduler completion and restart without resend
Interrupted sending claim becomes uncertain at startup
Reused occurrence with a changed body is rejected
Only a confirmed action permits continuation to a following action
Additive journal migration preserves legacy reminder rows in an offline synthetic copy without changing the source database
